answer: An electric fan uses an electric motor to spin blades that push air forward. The motor sits in a housing behind the blades, and a guard cage keeps fingers out.
title: Electric fan
intro: Your screen is blank, so I built a standard electric fan from its real parts.
summary: The motor turns the blades, which push air through the guard and cool you down.
note: Never touch the blades while the fan is running.

parts.label: Base
parts.say: The heavy round base keeps the fan standing steady on the floor.

parts.label: Stand pole
parts.say: A metal pole rises from the base and holds the head up at a comfortable height.

parts.label: Motor housing
parts.say: The electric motor sits inside this housing at the top of the pole and turns the blades.

parts.label: Blades
parts.say: Five blades spin around the motor shaft and push air forward.

parts.label: Safety guard
parts.say: The wire guard surrounds the blades so fingers cannot reach them.
